(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil configured for positioning about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil around the power cable.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directable along said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

(Currently Amended) Claim 21: The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including positioning said coil around a power cable feeding said transducer or generator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil configured for positioning around a power cable extending to said handpiece, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil around the power cable.
